plan: Create system page for the Body Lock System. The body lock is referenced in 10+ positions and transitions (Back Control, Standing Rear Clinch, Crab Ride, Turtle, Bodylock Pass) but lacks a dedicated system overview. Target: no-gi grapplers and wrestlers; high search volume for 'body lock system BJJ Gordon Ryan'. Sections: what is body lock system, establishing the grip, mat return sequence, back take variations, guard passing with body lock, bodylock pass, counter-defense flow.

Create transition page for Body Lock Mat Return. Referenced in Body Lock Top optimal submission paths as primary path to back control but lacks standalone article. Target: intermediate/advanced no-gi grapplers. Sections: setup from body lock top, trip mechanics, driving through opponent, securing back hooks before releasing lock, common errors.

Create transition page for Estima Lock Entry. The Estima Lock position JSON describes the submission but there is no dedicated entry/setup transition page. Target: leg lock practitioners, no-gi grapplers. Sections: entry from 50-50 guard, entry from single leg X-guard, entry from outside ashi, grip configuration steps, hip positioning, common errors during entry.

Create principles page for Leg Lock Defense. Referenced in Estima Lock Bottom, Ashi Garami Bottom, and multiple leg entanglement positions but no unified defense principles article exists. Target: all levels; high search volume for 'how to defend leg locks BJJ'. Sections: general tapping philosophy, heel hook defense, straight ankle lock defense, Estima lock defense, knee bar defense, when to tap vs escape.
